name: Making Contact
summary: A sentinel asks you to find a kaldorei woman spotted on the Shattered Strand. Her purpose is unknown, and your expedition hopes to learn whether her interests align with theirs.

sections.title: Along the Coast
sections.body: A sentinel on the Shattered Strand asks you to seek a kaldorei woman last seen on the north side of the Bay of Storms. She is not part of the expedition, and the sentinel doubts she is a fighter. Find her and learn why she is there, and whether her purpose matches the expedition's.

faq.q: Who is asking me to find the woman?
faq.answer: A sentinel from the expedition asks you to find the kaldorei woman and learn why she is there.

faq.q: Where was the kaldorei woman last seen?
faq.answer: She was last seen along the north side of the Bay of Storms on the Shattered Strand.

faq.q: Why does the expedition want to speak with her?
faq.answer: The expedition wants to learn her purpose and whether her interests align with theirs.

faq.q: Is the woman part of the expedition?
faq.answer: No. The sentinel says she is not with the expedition.
